text_en: Then Jesus told them a parable about their need to pray always and not to lose heart.
text_cn: 耶稣给他们设了一个比喻，论及人应当时常祈祷，不要灰心。

text_en: He said, “In a certain city there was a judge who neither feared God nor had respect for people.
text_cn: 他说：“某城中曾有一个判官不敬畏天主，也不敬重人。

text_en: In that city there was a widow who kept coming to him and saying, ‘Grant me justice against my opponent. ’
text_cn: 在那城中另有一个寡妇，常去见他说：请你制裁我的对头，给我伸冤罢！

text_en: For a while he refused; but later he said to himself, ‘Though I have no fear of God and no respect for anyone,
text_cn: 他多时不肯；以后想道：我虽不敬畏天主，也不敬重人，

text_en: yet because this widow keeps bothering me, I will grant her justice, so that she may not wear me out by continually coming. ’”
text_cn: 只因为这个寡妇常来烦扰我，我要给她伸冤，免得她不断的来纠缠我。

text_en: And the Lord said, “Listen to what the unjust judge says.
text_cn: 于是主说：你们听听这个不义的判官说的什么！

text_en: And will not God grant justice to his chosen ones who cry to him day and night? Will he delay long in helping them?
text_cn: 天主所召选的人，日夜呼吁他，他岂能不给他们伸冤，而迁延俯听他们吗？

text_en: I tell you, he will quickly grant justice to them. And yet, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on earth? ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：他必要快快为他们伸冤，但是，人子来临时，能在世上找到信德吗？”

text_en: He also told this parable to some who trusted in themselves that they were righteous and regarded others with contempt:
text_cn: 耶稣也向几个自充为义人，而轻视他人的人，设了这个比喻：

text_en: “Two men went up to the temple to pray, one a Pharisee and the other a tax collector.
text_cn: “有两个人上圣殿去祈祷：一个是法利塞人，另一个是税吏。

text_en: The Pharisee, standing by himself, was praying thus, ‘God, I thank you that I am not like other people: thieves, rogues, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.
text_cn: 那个法利塞人立着，心里这样祈祷：天主，我感谢你，因为我不像其他的人，勒索、不义、奸淫，也不像这个税吏。

text_en: I fast twice a week; I give a tenth of all my income. ’
text_cn: 我每周两次禁食，凡我所得的，都捐献十分之一。

text_en: But the tax collector, standing far off, would not even look up to heaven, but was beating his breast and saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner! ’
text_cn: 那个税吏却远远地站着，连举目望天都不敢，只是捶着自己的胸膛说：天主，可怜我这个罪人罢！

text_en: I tell you, this man went down to his home justified rather than the other; for all who exalt themselves will be humbled, but all who humble themselves will be exalted. ”
text_cn: 我告诉你们：这人下去，到他家里，成了正义的，而那个人却不然。因为凡高举自己的，必被贬抑；凡贬抑自己的，必被高举。”

text_en: People were bringing even infants to him that he might touch them; and when the disciples saw it, they sternly ordered them not to do it.
text_cn: 有人也把婴孩带到耶稣跟前，要他抚摸他们；门徒们见了便斥责他们。

text_en: But Jesus called for them and said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not stop them; for it is to such as these that the kingdom of God belongs.
text_cn: 耶稣却召唤他们说：“你们让小孩子们到我跟前来，不要阻止他们！因为天主的国正属于这样的人。

text_en: Truly I tell you, whoever does not receive the kingdom of God as a little child will never enter it. ”
text_cn: 我实在告诉你们：谁若不像小孩子一样接受天主的国，决不能进去。”

text_en: A certain ruler asked him, “Good Teacher, what must I do to inherit eternal life? ”
text_cn: 有一个首领问耶稣说：“善师，我要做什么，才能承受永生？”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but God alone.
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“你为什么称我善呢？除了天主一个外，没有谁是善的。

text_en: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not commit adultery; You shall not murder; You shall not steal; You shall not bear false witness; Honor your father and mother. ’”
text_cn: 诫命你都知道：不可奸淫，不可杀人，不可偷盗，不可作假见证；应孝敬你的父母。”

text_en: He replied, “I have kept all these since my youth. ”
text_cn: 那人说：“这一切我自幼就都遵守了。”

text_en: When Jesus heard this, he said to him, “There is still one thing lacking. Sell all that you own and distribute the money to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me. ”
text_cn: 耶稣听后，便向他说：“你还缺少一样：把你一切所有的都变卖了，施舍给穷人，你必有宝藏在天上，然后来跟随我！”

text_en: But when he heard this, he became sad; for he was very rich.
text_cn: 那人听了这话，异常悲伤，因为他是个很富有的人。

text_en: Jesus looked at him and said, “How hard it is for those who have wealth to enter the kingdom of God!
text_cn: 耶稣见他如此，便说：“那些有钱财的人，进入天主的国是多么难啊！

text_en: Indeed, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God. ”
text_cn: 骆驼穿过针孔，比富有的人进入天主的国还容易。”

text_en: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved? ”
text_cn: 听众遂说：“这样，谁还能得救呢？”

text_en: He replied, “What is impossible for mortals is possible for God. ”
text_cn: 耶稣说：“在人所不能的，在天主是可能的。”

text_en: Then Peter said, “Look, we have left our homes and followed you. ”
text_cn: 伯多禄说：“看，我们舍弃了我们的一切所有，跟随了你！”

text_en: And he said to them, “Truly I tell you, there is no one who has left house or wife or brothers or parents or children, for the sake of the kingdom of God,
text_cn: 耶稣向他们说：“我实在告诉你们：人为了天主的国舍弃了房屋、或妻子、或兄弟、或父母、或子女，

text_en: who will not get back very much more in this age, and in the age to come eternal life. ”
text_cn: 没有不在今世获得多倍，而在来世获得永生的。”

text_en: Then he took the twelve aside and said to them, “See, we are going up to Jerusalem, and everything that is written about the Son of Man by the prophets will be accomplished.
text_cn: 耶稣把那十二人带到一边，对他们说：“看！我们上耶路撒冷去，凡藉先知所写的一切，都要成就在人子身上：

text_en: For he will be handed over to the Gentiles; and he will be mocked and insulted and spat upon.
text_cn: 他要被交于外邦人，要受戏弄、侮辱及唾污。

text_en: After they have flogged him, they will kill him, and on the third day he will rise again. ”
text_cn: 人在鞭挞他之后，还要杀害他；但第三天他要复活。”

text_en: But they understood nothing about all these things; in fact, what he said was hidden from them, and they did not grasp what was said.
text_cn: 这些话他们一点也不懂，这话为他们是隐秘的；他所说的事，他们也不明白。

text_en: As he approached Jericho, a blind man was sitting by the roadside begging.
text_cn: 耶稣将近耶里哥时，有一个瞎子坐在路旁讨饭，

text_en: When he heard a crowd going by, he asked what was happening.
text_cn: 听见群众路过，便查问是什么事。

text_en: They told him, “Jesus of Nazareth is passing by. ”
text_cn: 有人告诉他：是纳匝肋人耶稣经过。

text_en: Then he shouted, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me! ”
text_cn: 他便喊叫说：“耶稣，达味之子，可怜我罢！”

text_en: Those who were in front sternly ordered him to be quiet; but he shouted even more loudly, “Son of David, have mercy on me! ”
text_cn: 前面走的人就斥责他，叫他不要出声；但他越发喊叫说：“达味之子，可怜我罢！”

text_en: Jesus stood still and ordered the man to be brought to him; and when he came near, he asked him,
text_cn: 耶稣站住，叫人把他带到自己跟前来；当他来近时，耶稣问他说：

text_en: “What do you want me to do for you? ” He said, “Lord, let me see again. ”
text_cn: “你愿意我给你做什么？”他说：“主，叫我看见。”

text_en: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight; your faith has saved you. ”
text_cn: 耶稣给他说：“你看见罢！你的信德救了你。”

text_en: Immediately he regained his sight and followed him, glorifying God; and all the people, when they saw it, praised God.
text_cn: 他立刻看见了，遂跟随着耶稣，光荣天主。所有的百姓见了，也都颂扬天主。
